00044 RawInputUGenInternal::RawInputUGenInternal(const int numChannels) throw()
00045 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, numChannels - 1)
00046 {
00047     ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00048     
00049     bufferData = new const float*[numChannels];
00050     memset(bufferData, 0, numChannels * sizeof(float*));
00051 }
00052 
00053 RawInputUGenInternal::~RawInputUGenInternal() throw()
00054 {
00055     delete [] bufferData;
00056 }
00057 
00058 void RawInputUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00059 {
00060     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00061     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00062     
00063     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00064     {
00065         const float* inputSamples = bufferData[i];
00066         if(inputSamples != 0)
00067             memcpy(proxies[i]->getSampleData(), inputSamples, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00068     }
00069     
00070     // invalidate the buffer pointers..
00071     memset(bufferData, 0, numChannels * sizeof(float*));
00072 }
00073 
00074 AudioIn::AudioIn(const int numChannels) throw()
00075 {
00076     ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00077     
00078     initInternal(numChannels);
00079     generateFromProxyOwner(new RawInputUGenInternal(numChannels));
00080 }
